reviews.review: A keeper that marks the controlled alternative before it recombines dephases the measurement. Require a physically tagged comparison, including the environment. Distinguish an idle remote keeper firing from predicting a shared bit and learning its full answer. Every physical encoding must be lawful even when the logical homogeneous word violates a not-all-equal output rule. Separate the complete-history obstruction from fresh-run agreement.

The retained, ignored and coherently uncomputed tag controls, lawful ternary registers and post-outcome writes distinguish coherence from a durable which-alternative record. The unilateral control distinguishes a remote keeper firing, predicting the shared bit, and predicting the full word. The unconditional sweep bound retains failures and repeat flips. Distinguish a selected-device refusal, a mask-class contradiction and the all-quantum obstruction.
